 Weathering and Lightfastness Testing
 Weathering Test Standards 
International Test Standards for Weathering
Q-Lab's robust line of accelerated weathering test chambers are capable of meeting a variety of internationally recognized standards from organizations such as ASTM and ISO. To view all of the standards our accelerated weathering test chambers can meet, head to our Standards Selector Tool. Visit our FAQ page to see some of the most common questions we receive regarding test standards for weathering.

 Corrosion Testing
 Equipment & Accessories 
Corrosion Equipment and Accessories
Cyclic corrosion testing provides the best laboratory simulation of natural atmospheric corrosion.
In just a few days or weeks, Q‑Lab’s line of Q‑FOG test chambers can reproduce the damage that occurs over months or years outdoors.
 CYCLIC CORROSION TESTERS
Q‑FOG SSP corrosion chambers can perform traditional salt spray and Prohesion testing. Q-FOG CCT models add the capability to run some cyclic automotive tests that require specimen wetting. Q‑FOG testers are the simplest, most reliable, and easiest-to-use corrosion chambers available.
Learn More
 CONTROLLED RH CORROSION TESTERS
Q‑FOG CRH testers can perform even the most demanding modern cyclic automotive corrosion tests. Relative humidity control and a full range of accessories enable the Q-FOG CRH tester to meet all your corrosion testing needs.
Learn More
 Mass-Loss Coupons
CX series  corrosion coupons are designed to meet the stringent requirements specified in modern corrosion test methods. Like all Q‑PANEL standard substrates, they are consistent, clean, convenient, and cost‑effective.
Learn More

 Q-Lab Leadership in International Standards Committees 
Q-Lab Leadership in International Standard Committees
Q-Lab is proud to have a strong voice in numerous international standard committees. Q-Lab takes a leadership role in standards and technical committee leadership worldwide, serving as committee chairs and as project leaders for development of new and revised standards. We are active in ASTM, ISO, ASTM, SAE, GB, and other committees, working to ensure that standards are fair and accessible to all users.
